tier_rationale: Downgraded from seed Tier 2 assignment. The discovery source classified this vendor as 'Tier 2: Top-rated Finnrick vendor' with third-party Finnrick COAs, GLP-1s, and Ipamorelin. However, profiling reveals astropeptides.com is a pre-launch placeholder site with zero published products (WooCommerce store API returns empty array []), a shop page that explicitly states 'Our store is in the works and will be launching soon!', no live product URLs, no COA pages, no pricing, and no actual peptide SKUs anywhere on the site. The Finnrick vendor claim cannot be verified against any observable site data. The site has four generic AI-generated blog posts from March 2025 and a Lorem ipsum-filled jewelry template with placeholder text throughout the homepage. No evidence of any transactional activity or real product catalog. Tier 3 baseline profile is the maximum justifiable depth.
